CI_setup: Original integration Ubuntu26/Python3.12.13/uv0.11.21/frozen lock and fixed sandbox package pins; no new provider or environment permission
original_baseline_workflow: UNCHANGED; push matches main/feat/**/fix/**, not qa/**
scope: Auxiliary named8 actual regression gate for unchanged reviewed1be8 implementation; not product semantics or full-baseline replacement
workflow:
name: Bounded evidence recovery8 named regression validation
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - qa/M6.3-bounded-evidence-recovery-8
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  recovery8-named-cases:
    if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && github.ref == 'refs/heads/qa/M6.3-bounded-evidence-recovery-8' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Verify unchanged reviewed implementation and exact parent
        run: |
          git log -1 --format=%H
          git rev-parse HEAD^
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "1be8fc671e4821de953a0771c887c129b6e90294"
          git diff --exit-code 1be8fc671e4821de953a0771c887c129b6e90294 -- services/api tests/integration pyproject.toml uv.lock PRODUCT_DESIGN.md
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.13'
      - run: python -m pip install uv==0.11.21
      - run: uv sync --frozen
      - name: Install original fixed document sandbox dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap=0.11.1-1ubuntu0.3 apparmor=5.0.2-0ubuntu1~26.04.1 libapparmor1=5.0.2-0ubuntu1~26.04.1 libseccomp2=2.6.0-2ubuntu5
          dpkg-query -W bubblewrap apparmor libapparmor1 libseccomp2
          test -f /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap-userns-restrict
          bwrap --version
      - name: Run only the eight reviewed recovery cases with individual outcomes
        run: |
          uv run --frozen pytest -vv -rA \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_scan_caps_raw_prefix_before_bound_history_filters' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_stop_is_checked_on_already_handled_rows_and_keeps_cursor[bound]' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_stop_is_checked_on_already_handled_rows_and_keeps_cursor[failed]' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_commit_failure_does_not_advance_cursor_or_lose_item' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_workspace_round_is_fair_and_new_workspace_is_revisited' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_active_guard_defers_without_losing_grade_prefix' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_recovery_scan_revisits_new_completion_and_revision_after_frozen_epoch' \
            'tests/integration/test_learning_evidence.py::test_dispatch_keeps_same_tick_real_grading_after_handled_recovery_slice'
